description: Load one sync run's full detail — per-stage results, progress, lookback window and pending batch count. Use after sm_list_sync_runs to explain why data is stale or a run failed. Failure detail lands in one of two places and rarely both: orchestration failures set run.errorMessage with no stage rows, while per-data-type failures leave it null and record the message on results[].errorMessage, so check both and treat status as the failure signal.

projectId.description: Required. The opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters to scope this request to. Call GET /_api/public/v1/enterprise/projects to list the project IDs available to your API key. Omitting it returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

runId.description: The opaque 8-character hash ID correlating to the sync run.

name: sm_get_sync_run

outputSchema.description: Output for the sm_get_sync_run tool. Failure payloads arrive in the same envelope as { error, code }.

code.description: A machine-readable identifier for the error type. For the full code taxonomy, see the sm_get_schema tool or the Enterprise API OpenAPI ErrorResponse component.

error.description: A human-readable error message detailing what went wrong.

lookbackWindowDays.description: Number of days of history the sync covers.

pendingBatchCount.description: Number of batches still queued for processing.

progress.description: Per-data-type progress rows for the sync run.

items.description: In-flight progress for a sync run. Rows exist only during an active sync.

currentPhase.description: Free text phase description, not an enum.

dataType.description: Data type for the progress row.

totalLists.description: Total lists in scope, or null.

projectId.description: An opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters identifying a Space Monkey Project. Treat this value as entirely opaque; do not parse, sequentialize, or auto-generate it.

results.description: Per-stage results for the sync run.

items.description: Result row for a specific data type in a sync run. The row's `id` is deliberately dropped by the endpoint, making `dataType` the distinguishing key.

dataType.description: Free-form varchar (not an enum). Observed values: automations, campaign_reports, campaigns, email_activities, lists, member_activities, members, reports, segments, tags.

finalTableRowCount.description: Final table row count, or null.

recordsSkipped.description: Records skipped in the stage, or null.

recordsWritten.description: Records written in the stage, or null.

totalRecords.description: Records in the stage, or null.

run.description: Details for a specific sync run. Omits projectName, retryCount, resultsCount, and totalTables carried by the list row.

errorMessage.description: Failure detail, or null on success.

status.description: Run status, for example queued, running, completed, or failed.

title: Get sync run detail
